# Custom domains for generated BYOW sites (Cloudflare for SaaS)

Let customers attach their own domain (e.g. `www.theirbiz.com`) to a site they generated in Pixcellor. Cloudflare for SaaS issues SSL automatically, and a Cloudflare Worker maps the incoming `Host` header to the right `/s/:ref` page.

## Customer flow (what they see)

1. Open a generated site → "Settings" → **Connect a domain**.
2. Enter their domain (e.g. `www.theirbiz.com`). We show them one DNS record to add at their registrar:
   - Type: `CNAME`, Host: `www`, Value: `sites.pixcellor.com`
   - (For a root/apex domain, instructions to use ALIAS/ANAME or a www-redirect.)
3. We call Cloudflare's Custom Hostnames API to register their hostname; Cloudflare issues a TXT ownership-validation record we also display.
4. Customer hits **Verify**. We poll Cloudflare; status moves `pending → active`. SSL is auto-provisioned.
5. Once active, visiting their domain serves their generated site, branded under their URL. A status badge shows live/pending/error with the exact next step.
6. CTA: *Want this customised further? Hire our team.* (links to existing "Let's talk" flow).

## Pieces to build

### 1. Cloudflare for SaaS setup (one-time, by you)
- Add a "Fallback Origin" in Cloudflare (your project's apex, e.g. `pixcellor.com` or the proxy host) and a SaaS CNAME target like `sites.pixcellor.com`.
- Create an API token scoped to: `Zone:SSL and Certificates:Edit`, `Zone:Custom Hostnames:Edit`, `Zone:Zone:Read` for the pixcellor.com zone.
- Add 3 runtime secrets: `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN`, `CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID`, `CLOUDFLARE_SAAS_CNAME_TARGET` (e.g. `sites.pixcellor.com`).

### 2. Database
New table `byow_custom_domains` (per-site, per-customer):
- site reference (FK → `byow_generated_sites.ref`), owner `user_id`, `hostname`, `cf_custom_hostname_id`, `status` (`pending_dns | pending_ssl | active | error | removed`), `ownership_verification` jsonb (record name + value Cloudflare returned), `ssl_status`, `last_checked_at`, `error_message`.
- RLS: owner can CRUD their rows; service_role full access; admins read all. GRANTs for `authenticated` + `service_role`.
- Unique index on lowercased `hostname`.

### 3. Edge functions
- `byow-domain-connect` — input `{ ref, hostname }`. Verifies the caller owns the site, calls CF `POST /zones/{zone}/custom_hostnames`, stores the row, returns DNS instructions (CNAME target + ownership TXT).
- `byow-domain-status` — polls CF for one row, updates `status` / `ssl_status` / `error_message`, returns latest.
- `byow-domain-delete` — removes from CF and marks row `removed`.
- Free-plan rule: free users get 0 custom domains; paid/admin = unlimited. Reuses the same active-sub + admin check already in `byow-generate-site`.

### 4. Routing worker (Cloudflare Worker on `sites.pixcellor.com`)
- Reads incoming `Host` header.
- Looks up the mapping via a small public edge endpoint `byow-resolve-host?host=...` returning `{ ref }` (cached at the edge ~60s).
- Proxies the request to `https://pixcellor.com/s/{ref}<path>` and streams response, preserving status/headers. Rewrites any absolute self-links to the customer's hostname if needed.
- 404 page when no mapping exists, with link back to pixcellor.com.

### 5. UI
- New tab/section "Domains" inside the existing site editor (`/byow/edit/:ref`):
  - Empty state with **Connect domain** button.
  - Modal: input → submit → shows the DNS records to copy, a **Verify** button that calls `byow-domain-status`, and live status pill.
  - Once active: shows `https://hostname` link, "Make primary", "Disconnect", and the "Hire our team to customise further" CTA.
- In `ByowSitesTab` site cards, show a small "🌐 hostname" chip when a domain is active.
- All copy uses the existing black/white glass theme; framer-motion for entrance.

### 6. SEO / canonical
- When a request comes in on a customer domain, set the page's canonical URL to `https://hostname/` instead of `https://pixcellor.com/s/{ref}` so we don't compete with their domain in search.

## Technical notes (for review)

- Cloudflare for SaaS handles SSL via SNI; no per-domain cert work for us.
- Apex domains (`theirbiz.com` with no `www`) are a known pain point — instructions will recommend `www.theirbiz.com` + a registrar-level redirect for the apex. We do not try to provision apex CNAME flattening ourselves in v1.
- Domain limit per site: 2 (primary + one alias) to keep abuse low; configurable.
- We never store registrar credentials — customer edits DNS at their own provider.
- Polling: client polls `byow-domain-status` every ~8s while the modal is open; server-side we also re-check on each call.

## Out of scope (v1)
- Buying a domain for the customer inside Pixcellor (the existing Porkbun `register-domain` flow is unrelated and stays as-is for the agency/lead funnel).
- Per-site email DNS (MX/SPF/DKIM).
- Auto-removing inactive domains.

## Confirmation needed before build
- You'll provide the Cloudflare API token, Zone ID, and the CNAME target hostname once we get to that step.
- Confirm: free plan = 0 custom domains, paid/admin = unlimited (max 2 per site).
